site.name: M/V HONDIUS
site.desc: WHO confirmed 9 cases and 3 deaths as of 14 May; vessel docked Canary Islands to allow passenger evacuation to home countries. En route Rotterdam with skeleton crew of 30 + Dutch nurse for full disinfection; future Arctic cruise schedule uncertain pending health authority authorization per AP News.

site.name: ILLINOIS
site.desc: Winnebago County resident suspected of contracting hantavirus (North African variant, not Andes) after cleaning a rodent-infested property per The Daily Beast; health officials believe exposure via aerosolized rat urine or feces. Case assessed as unrelated to MV Hondius outbreak; showing mild symptoms, not hospitalized, and recovering per The Daily Beast.
